body:
PR149's exact 1,433-column checkpoint continued to 1,604 retained columns (+171) without changing the scientific model or replaying completed solves. This draft freezes the terminal checkpoint, receipts and full-pool audit; no new multi-column harvesting development or benchmark is included.

The smallest audited RMP upper decreased from 0.5769475518070709 to 0.5741861223241257. The certified interval is [0.5687115725336208, 0.5741861223241257], with the PR147 Arc-LP floor and material threshold 0.5737116104747505 preserved. Materiality remains INCONCLUSIVE and exact CG convergence is false. Final same-true-dual pricing has three OPTIMAL negative reduced costs and one TIME_LIMIT receipt with a valid global BestBd; that incumbent is never used as a lower bound or exact optimum.

Validation:
- Final pool audit: 1,604 columns; 2,033 frozen raw file hashes and all 12,106 PR149 tracked files preserved.
- Independent original-matrix/primal-point, rational corrected-bound and segmented-budget rechecks PASS.
- Native union: 1,367.2886372 / 1,800 seconds across the carried segments; 432.7113628 seconds remain unused after the reserve stop and the user's final freeze instruction.
- Semantic pytest: 204 passed. Full pytest: 1,882 passed, one existing calibration RuntimeWarning. Concurrent heavy native solve during tests: 0.
- Compile/static verification, git diff --check and SHA256 manifest verification PASS.

Four-way pricing, Threads=1, adaptive Discovery smoothing, true-dual acceptance and Certification, and PR144 selected runtime flags remain unchanged. Historical low-resource interruptions are retained in the ledger and excluded from certificates. Other lanes were not killed or edited. Branch-and-Price and May production were not run in this lane. Additional Discovery/RMP/pricing and multi-column work are stopped.

The Korean report and evidence are under docs/v42_m1_dw_root_continuation_v2/FINAL_REVIEW_KO.md. Base is PR149 exact head 867b86d2c503dfb991f08f27c3240c69aeba5153 on codex/v42-m1-dw-accelerated-root-integration-v1.
